actors.name: Marlin Bay Unified school board (as a body)
actors.private_context: The board has the proposal on its agenda for both September meetings. Two trustees are up for re-election in November. The board is aware that the proposal has been tabled twice and that a parent group plans to pack public comment.

actors.name: Parent group
actors.private_context: The group has organized to pack the public-comment period at the September meetings to pressure the board to take a recorded vote on the later-start-times proposal.

shared_context: The Marlin Bay Unified school board holds two meetings in September 2026. The later-start-times proposal is on the agenda for both meetings. The board can take a recorded vote at either meeting. The parent group has publicly stated they will pack the public-comment period.

starting_events.description: The school board's September meeting schedule is set, with the later-start-times proposal on the agenda for both meetings.
visible_to: Marlin Bay Unified school board (as a body)

resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the school board took a recorded vote on the later-start-times proposal at either of its two September meetings before the cutoff. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
